about: Grade-separation check on roads_3d.geojson (pipeline/checks/grade_separation.py). Reports only; nothing in the contract files is changed. Heights are visual: clearance-based, measured where roads_3d's z_source says so.
licence: Derived from OpenStreetMap data, ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors

clearance_sensitivity.note: crossings (different layers, no tunnel pending) whose upper road is at least this many metres above the lower one

summary.order_mismatch_cause: Clearance-based heights (roads_3d.py): each upper deck sits a measured or default separation above what is beneath it, so a mismatch can only come from a crossing roads_3d had to drop (the lower road joins the upper deck too close for the grade limits; listed in its build summary). See lifted_by_* / lift_distance_m / grade_needed on any order_mismatch and separated_low record.
